description: Phase W13-1 runtime snapshot shape for world/data/runtime/orders.json. Presentation-only reflection of the read-only composite view execution.order_timeline.OrderTimeline already produces - not a source of truth (that remains OrderTimeline for order-timeline state and system_health.reconciliation.ReconciliationEngine for reconciliation, neither of which this schema or anything in world/ reads from or writes to directly - see telemetry/world_export.py, the only bridge). The optional top-level `reconciliation` object mirrors ReconciliationEngine.status() verbatim; every one of its fields is independently optional and omitted (not fabricated as 0/null) when the engine hadn't produced a value this capture.

state.description: One of execution.order_timeline.TimelineState's composite values (NEW/SUBMITTED/ACKNOWLEDGED/PARTIALLY_FILLED/FILLED/OPEN/REDUCING/CLOSING/CLOSED/FAILED/CANCELLED), or null if OrderTimeline has no last-known state for this symbol yet.

reconciliation.description: Optional - system_health.reconciliation.ReconciliationEngine.status() verbatim. Absent entirely when the engine hasn't run this capture.
